$comment: Frozen inputs of the 0.14.0 ledger (hds#462), read by scripts/upgrade/build-ledger.mjs. 0.14.0 shipped before ledgers existed, so its record was written after the fact from its snapshot (docs/api/releases/0.14.0.json) and its CHANGELOG section. Each CHANGELOG.md:<line> is numbered as the file read when 0.14.0 shipped (its section starts on line 3); its needle is the text that finds the line, and opens with the commit of the entry when the entry names one.
summary: TenantProvider takes the tenant as a slug prop, dev warnings fire in consumer builds, and types resolve under node16.

steps.subject: TenantProvider-slug
steps.plain: TenantProvider no longer reads VITE_TENANT_SLUG, which never worked once installed; pass the tenant as its slug prop, or it sets no data-brand or data-tenant attribute.
